payment.holiday_deferral_rule: If the interest payment date is a statutory holiday or rest day, it is postponed to the next trading day, with no additional interest during the postponement period.

put.accrued_interest_rule: Repurchase at the bond face value plus accrued interest for the current period.
put.annual_exercise_limit: The holder may exercise the repurchase right once per interest accrual year after the repurchase conditions are first satisfied.
put.put_price_rule: Repurchase at the bond face value plus accrued interest for the current period.

redemption.accrued_interest_redemption_rule: Redeem at the bond face value plus accrued interest for the current period.
redemption.maturity_redemption_price_rule: Redeem at 115% of the bond face value, including the final-period interest.
